blocks.html: Kids are King as Music and Magic Reign at Robinsons Malls This Christmas

Celebrate the holidays on a high note and bring your little ones to Robinsons Malls for a yuletide experience they’ll never forget. Watch the wonder on their faces when their favorite TV and fairytale characters come to life right before their eyes. It’s definitely a Christmas wish come true when the Hi-5 gang goes on a musical adventure to find out the true meaning of the season in the Jingle Jangle Christmas show! An awesome experience is also in store as a live production from Australia brings together the best-loved fairytale characters in An Enchanting Christmas. Meet and greet sessions with some amazing new friends are also lined up, so remember to clear these dates on your calendar for an unforgettable Christmas for kids!

Catchy tunes and upbeat dance steps are the order of the day as Hi-5 celebrates all things Christmas-y in the Jingle Jangle Christmas show. Kids’ favorite Hi-5 songs are featured alongside Christmas classics—certain to make the young and the young at heart sing and dance along! Join the gang as they learn the true meaning of Christmas through their signature, infectious Hi-5 music. Rudolph might even make a special appearance. Who knows what other surprises are in the horizon?

Catch the Jingle Jangle Christmas show at Robinsons Metro East on December 14 at 2 p.m. and 4 p.m.; Robinsons Place Manila on December 15 at 2 p.m. and 4 p.m.; Robinsons Galleria-Ortigas on December 16 at 1 p.m. and Robinsons Magnolia on December 16 as well at 4 p.m. and 6 p.m.

Wouldn’t it be wonderful to celebrate a beautiful white Christmas with Cinderella in Enchanted Land? Her handsome Prince Charming and her best friend Snow White are there to make sure that she plans the perfect celebration. There’s just one problem: the Christmas Star is missing, and without it, there will be no Christmas magic. As if that’s not enough, the Ice Queen is out to spread a blanket of darkness across the wintery white Enchanted Land. Will these stop Cinderella and her friends from celebrating An Enchanting Christmas?

Find out what happens in this live production from Australia, replete with beautiful costumes, wonderful music, and lots of Christmas fun! Watch out for An Enchanting Christmas at Robinsons Metro East, Robinsons Place Dumaguete and Robinsons Place Roxas on November 30; Robinsons Place GenTri, Robinsons Place Tagum and Robinsons Place Jaro on December 1; Robinsons Sta. Rosa, Robinsons Place Naga and Robinsons Place Butuan on December 2; Robinsons Starmills, Robinsons Place Ilocos and Robinsons Place Palawan on December 8; Robinsons Novaliches, Robinsons Place GenSan and Robinsons Place Bacolod on December 9; Robinsons Place Antipolo, Robinsons North Tacloban and Robinsons Otis on December 15; Robinsons Place Dasmariñas, Robinsons Place Ormoc and Robinsons Cybergate Cebu on December 16; Robinsons Place Malolos, Forum Robinsons and Robinsons Place Iligan on December 17; Robinsons Place Lipa, Robinsons Place Tuguegarao and Robinsons Angeles on December 18; Robinsons Place Imus, Robinsons Place Santiago and Robinsons Place Pangasinan on December 19; Robinsons Place Las Piñas and Robinsons Town Mall Malabon on December 20. All shows start at 2 p.m. and 4 p.m.

The world’s much-loved bunch of fluffy friends is in town and they’re teaching an important lesson this Christmas. In Be Who You Wanna Be, Jess is a singer who is about to go on her first world tour but doesn’t feel ready yet for the international stage. Each time she doubts herself, Bada, her friend and manager, gives her the confidence she needs to become a star. Will the two make it together? Mark your calendars for this mini show and meet and greet with Bada and friends at Robinsons Place Bacolod on November 18; Robinsons Metro East on November 24; Robinsons Place Las Piñas on November 30; Robinsons Place Lipa on December 1; Robinsons Place Pavia on December 2; Robinsons Galleria Cebu on December 8; Robinsons Place Dasmariñas on December 9; Robinsons Place Tacloban on December 13; Robinsons Place Tuguegarao on December 15 and Robinsons Place Ilocos on December 16. All shows start at 2 p.m. and 4 p.m.

Fun-loving and dressed up in colorful garb, twin genie sisters Shimmer and Shine are sure to delight Robinsons Malls shoppers with this special meet and greet activity. Catch them at Robinsons Place Manila on December 6 and Robinsons Galleria-Ortigas on December 7. Both shows start at 5 p.m. and 7 p.m. The fun continues at Robinsons Magnolia on December 8 and at Robinsons Galleria Cebu on December 9. Both shows start at 1 p.m., 3 p.m. and 5 p.m.
